opening.argument: The presentation requires participants to buy a platform level and bring in referrals to get paid, placing recruitment at the center of its earning pitch. It promotes free Ethereum and commission income as a potentially life-changing opportunity, claims wallet funds can be withdrawn to a bank account, and directs interested viewers to the sender. Those purchase and recruitment requirements support a scam finding based on recruitment commissions and tiered levels. The records do not establish actual payouts, participant losses, or the accuracy of the speaker’s claims.
